name: Duty-free and airport retail

problems.words: Shelves empty during the morning wave because replenishment only comes at night
quick_ideas: Note what sells out first in the morning wave for a week, because it shows what the night team should bring
Check hourly sales from your POS once, because the gaps follow the flight banks.

workzap_build.text: a replenishment planner using sales by SKU per flight wave, producing pick lists for each permitted window.

problems.ask_first: When are you allowed to bring stock through?
problems.free_stops: the planning model and pick-list logic are kept for the solution document.

problems.words: Stock counts don't match the records at month end
quick_ideas: Count one high-value category fully, because it shows where differences sit
Check transfers and write-offs for that category, because unrecorded moves cause most gaps.

workzap_build.text: small daily counts on phone reconciled with internal movement records, with variance reports; customs matters stay with your compliance team.

problems.ask_first: How often do you do full counts?
problems.free_stops: the count rotation and reconciliation method go in the solution document.

problems.words: Understaffed when several flights leave together, overstaffed at night
quick_ideas: Line up a week of hourly sales against your roster, because it shows where staff are mismatched
Move breaks out of the main waves, because that's when cover matters.

workzap_build.text: a roster planner driven by the flight schedule and hourly sales history.

problems.ask_first: How do you plan rosters today?
problems.free_stops: rostering rules are kept for the solution document.

quick_ideas: Write down what every handover must cover, because unwritten handovers drift

problems.words: Cash in several currencies and the till never balances
quick_ideas: Count each currency separately at one shift close, because it shows which one is off
Check the exchange rate the till used, because stale rates cause gaps.

problems.words: Brand promotions aren't set up on time
quick_ideas: List every live promotion and check it on the floor once, because it shows what was missed
Name one person per outlet for promotions, because shared tasks slip.

problems.words: Brand partners want sell-out data and airport reports take a day each month
quick_ideas: List every report you send and how long each takes, because it shows the real effort

problems.words: Transfers between terminal shops get lost

Have both ends sign every transfer, because it removes doubt.

never_say: Advice on customs, bond, excise, duty, passenger allowances, alcohol or tobacco licensing, or aviation security.
Help moving bonded goods improperly, selling to ineligible passengers or bypassing screening or the pass system.
Anything that needs boarding pass, passport, flight or nationality data on individuals, or staff ID and pass numbers.
For a security incident, suspicious item, fire or medical emergency, anything other than "alert airport security or emergency services now".
Legal or financial advice on concession contracts or rent.

sample_reply.person: We're a departures concession and our best sellers are gone an hour into the morning wave. Stock can only come through overnight. What can we do?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this can be improved. 1. Note what sells out first in the morning wave for a week, so the night team knows exactly what to bring. 2. Look at hourly sales from your POS once, because the gaps follow the flight banks. Workzap can do this automatically for you: pick lists for each overnight window built from sales per flight wave, every night, for every outlet. Would you like me to arrange a solution document and quote for you? You're welcome to say no.
